<thought>Using the most intense peak (m/z 268.1939) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is ≈267.1867 Da. Matching this mass with plausible organic formulas containing only C, H, and O gives the best fit as C₁₆H₂₇O₃ (monoisotopic neutral mass 267.1960 Da, [M+H]⁺ 268.2033 Da, within experimental error). The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 20 %) also aligns with ~16 carbons. Therefore the molecular formula is C16H27O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H27O3</final_answer>
